description:
## Changelog   
### ✨ Features   
* **feat(api):** detect GitHub Copilot CLI as coding agent ([a6652278](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a6652278)) by Srikanth Srinivas<!--community-->   
* **feat(df):** add glab df go ([a32c7988](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a32c7988)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **feat(govern):** send glab and agent versions with new sessions ([1bea3af3](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/1bea3af3)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(govern):** send the Codex tool namespace with tool call events ([9be88b25](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9be88b25)) by Dheeraj Joshi<!--team-->   
* **feat(release):** explain why CI_JOB_TOKEN can't close milestones ([8eb5e17c](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/8eb5e17c)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
### 🐛 Bug Fixes   
* **fix(api):** do not retry POST or PATCH on server errors ([f7503dc0](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/f7503dc0)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **fix(cluster):** show the real total in the list header ([e24e4adf](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e24e4adf)) by unstable-code<!--community-->   
* **fix(config):** send environment credentials only to trusted hosts ([6ab4be4d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/6ab4be4d)) by Dinesh Bolkensteyn<!--team-->   
* **fix(deps):** bump golang.org/x/net to v0.62.0 for GO-2026-6860 ([3454f28e](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/3454f28e)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **fix(orbit):** require GitLab Orbit CLI 0.163.0 or later ([a1910803](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a1910803)) by Aaron Algutifan<!--team-->   
* **fix(snap):** rename kubeconfig plug to dot-kube-config ([a9dfffbb](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a9dfffbb)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
### 📝 Documentation   
* **docs(df):** Update DFW docs ([887df4a8](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/887df4a8)) by Isaac Durham<!--team-->   
* **docs(security):** list profile identifiers in config help ([9d7364ef](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9d7364ef)) by Isaac Durham<!--team-->   
* **docs:** fix contributor and maintainer doc gaps ([31d08322](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/31d08322)) by Khaled Adel<!--community-->   
### 🔧 Maintenance   
* **chore:** Add gitlab-bot to CODEOWNERS so automated approvals of MRs satisfy requirements ([edf45cc2](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/edf45cc2)) by Matt Nohr<!--team-->   
### 📦 Dependencies   
* **chore(deps):** update module github.com/docker/cli to v29.9.2+incompatible ([97b69284](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/97b69284)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module github.com/docker/docker-credential-helpers to v0.9.12 ([bca2413e](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/bca2413e)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.39.1 ([b690423b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/b690423b)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
### 🔀 Others   
* **build:** use patch version 0 for the go directive ([7f554826](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/7f554826)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->
